content: We need a retrosynthesis route with at most 1 step (i.e., a single reaction) to produce target SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O. That's a methyl ester of a bicyclic ketone (maybe methyl 2-oxabicyclo? Actually structure: methyl ester of a bicyclic ketone (maybe methyl 2-oxabicyclo[2.2.2]oct-5-ene-3-carboxylate?). Anyway we need leaves (precursors) that are commercially available and total price <= $405. We don't have price data; but we can assume typical cheap reagents like methyl acetate, etc. Need to find a template that forms an ester from acid chloride? Or from carboxylic acid + methanol? The target is methyl ester of a carboxylic acid (maybe derived from acid). So a simple retrosynthesis: target -> carboxylic acid (same skeleton but with OH instead of OMe). Reaction: esterification (Fischer esterification) of acid with methanol. Template likely involves "carboxylic acid" broken and "carboxylic esters" formed. Let's search for templates with functional_groups_broken ["carboxylic acid"] and formed ["carboxylic esters"].
